retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist, surrealist character collage featuring hand-drawn, interlocking typography and melting, psychedelic facial features.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, multi-layered illustration of stylized, cartoonish faces and figures overlapping in a surreal landscape, anchored by large, hand-drawn display text that integrates into the character forms.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking characters forming a unified mosaic
Typography integrated as a physical layer within the scene
Melting and dripping textures connecting disparate elements
High-contrast black outlines defining flat color fields
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn, irregular line weights for all outlines
Overlapping character eyes and mouths creating a sense of depth
A central large face acting as the primary structural anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, central face occupies the middle ground, surrounded by smaller, densely packed characters that fill the entire frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central mouth and nose structure, along with the primary display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement starting from the top text, down through the central face, and spiraling out to the peripheral characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is maximalist with almost no unoccupied background area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones and skin tones (tan, beige, mauve)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purples and blacks for shadows and outlines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pops of yellow, red, and teal in small details
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Medium saturation with high value contrast between black outlines and light fill colors.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a flat, comic-book style shading

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke widths with a hand-inked feel
Letters follow the contours of the illustration
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals are rounded and slightly bulbous
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair custom display lettering with clean, small-scale sans-serif for metadata to maintain legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, surrealist aesthetic of the illustration.
Could serve as a skeleton for the bold, playful display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense, surrealist collage of cartoonish faces with melting features and thick black outlines in a muted pop-art palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, interlocking uppercase lettering with thick black outlines at the top and bottom, ensuring the letters feel like they are part of the character stack.

verificationChecks: Are the letters interlocking or overlapping?
Is the line work consistently hand-drawn and irregular?
Does the composition feel 'packed' with minimal negative space?
Are the colors flat with thick black outlines?

mustRedesign: Brand logos and Japanese OBI strip elements

mustAchieve: Cohesive hand-drawn line style across type and image

postGenerationChecks: Check for interlocking 'O' characters in the top text.
Ensure no white space is left at the edges of the composition.
Verify that the central face is the largest element.
Confirm all outlines are thick and black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Character Mosaic + Interlocking Hand-Lettering + Muted Pop Palette
